'''Keek''' was a [[Nomai]] from [[the Vessel]] who went missing after the Vessel crashed on [[Dark Bramble]]. Their partner [[Plume]] landed without them on [[Brittle Hollow]] with [[Escape Pods|Escape Pod 1]].<ref>PLUME: The pain of your absence is sharp and haunting, and I would give anything not to know it; anything but never knowing you at all (which would be worse). PLUME: I can only hope that you are safe, Keek, wherever you are.</ref> It appears that Keek was never found since they are not mentioned anywhere else.

== Trivia ==

* Keek is another name for the ''[[Wikipedia:Rorippa sylvestris|Rorippa sylvestris]]'', a plant which is part of the ''[[Wikipedia:Brassicaceae|Brassicaceae]]'' family of flowering plants.
